title: Deterministic Authorization Decoupling
rationale: Moving mutation authority outside the probabilistic generative loop prevents unauthorized repository writes and prompt-injection escapes.

title: SHA-256 Lineage Hash Chain Verification
rationale: Cryptographic chaining ensures historical records cannot be rewritten or forged by compromised agents without breaking the parent hash signature.

title: Shannon Entropy Secret Sanitization Gate
rationale: Blocks high-entropy synthetic API tokens, private keys, and passwords from entering persistent vector memory or git commit snapshots.
wrongDiff: return { pass: true }; // Rely on developer vigilance to never paste credentials

title: Recursive Execution Circuit Breaker
rationale: Unbounded iteration loops consume host compute and risk runaway agent sprawl. Enforcing hard step budgets halts divergence.

title: Dynamic Code Evaluation Token Prohibition
rationale: Direct execution of dynamic eval() or Function() on untrusted generative payloads allows arbitrary code execution in the runtime environment.
wrongDiff: eval(codePayload); // Directly executing model output in Node process

title: Worker Thread Termination on Subworld Shutdown
rationale: Child simulation worlds spawned in Web Workers must be explicitly terminated on parent tear-down to avoid zombie thread heap leaks.
wrongDiff: activeWorlds.delete(worldId); // Worker keeps running in background indefinitely
